verses.text: Te ow yak'an wejel t'a yol schonhab' heb' winh.
Ix lajwi'el ixim trigo xit' yik' heb' winh chi' swa'an winhaj Jacob yet' yuninal, ix yalanxi winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ixikekxi t'a Egipto, b'at manek jab'okxo tas sko wa'a, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Judá icha tik: --Te jichan ix yutej winh schonhan ixim trigo chi' yalani: Tato max heyik'kot winh heyuk'tak tzak'an unin chi', manhxo ol heyil hin sat t'a tik, xchi winh.
Yuj wal chi', tato sb'at winh kuk'tak tik ket'ok, tzonh b'at manoj trigo chi'.
Tato max ha chab'at winh ket' jun, manhxo ol honh b'atlaj, icha ix aj yalan winh chonhum trigo chi': Tato max heyik'kot winh heyuk'tak tzak'an unin chi', manhxo hex jawoklaj t'a wichanh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Israel chi' icha tik: --¿Tas yuj ix heyal t'a jun winh chi' to ay junokxo heyuk'tak? Tzin heyak' wal och t'a ilk'olal, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' winh icha tik: --Ix sk'anb'ej winh tastak kaji, mach ayonh yinhtilal. Ix sk'anb'anpax winh tato ayto'ek' ko mam, tato aytopax kuk'tak. Yuj chi' ix kal t'a winh to ayto'ek' ko mam, aytopax junxo kuk'tak. ¿Tokwal kojtak tato ol yal winh to skik'b'at winh kuk'tak tik? xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Judá t'a winh smam chi': --Tato max yal ha k'o'ol tzonh cham yuj wejel ko masanil, chab'at winh kuk'tak tik ket'ok. Ha hin tzin tek'b'ej hin b'a hin tanhwan winh, tato icha chi', tik tzonh b'at t'a elanhchamel.
Ha hin tzin tek'b'ej hin b'a tato ay tas tz'ik'an winh, tato manhxo ol ja winh wu'uj, te chuk ol hin kan t'a ha sat.
Tato maj ek' ko tiempo t'a tik, toxo ix kak' cha'elok na'ik, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh smam heb' winh chi' icha tik: --Tato manhxa tas wach' skutej, yik'okab' icha tzeyal chi', ixikek. Ik'ekb'at jab'ok he silab' t'a winh. Ha juntzanh tas wach' sk'ib' t'a tik, ha' tzeyik'b'ati: Haton bálsamo, nok' yalchab', perfume, mirra, te' nueces yet' te' almendras.
Ik'ekb'at he tumin yik tze manan ixim trigo chi', tzeyik'anxib'at k'e'en tumin ix yak' meltzaj heb' winh t'ayex t'a sti' he koxtal chi', tekan tonhej ix sat sk'o'ol heb' winh, yuj chi' ayem k'e'en.
Ik'ekb'at winh heyuk'tak tik, tzex b'atxi heyil winh yajal chi'.

Ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, ha' ol och t'a spensar winh yik ol aktajel winh heyuk'tak aj Simeón. Wach' ol aj smeltzajkot winhaj Benjamín tik heyet'ok. Ha hinxo tik, tato tzin kan manh uninal, hin kanokab'i, ¿tasto wal ol wutej? xchi winh smam heb' winh chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anem silab' heb' winh chi' t'a yol skoxtal yet' k'e'en tumin. Ix yik'anb'at winhaj Benjamín heb' winh, ix b'atxi heb' winh t'a Egipto chi'. Haxo yik ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh winhaj José,

ix yilan winh to ajun winhaj Benjamín chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a winh yilumal spat icha tik: --Ik'b'at juntzanh heb' winh tik t'a hin pat, tzak'an miljokcham junok nok' wakax, yik sb'o junok wa'el, to ol wa heb' winh wet'ok t'a chimk'uhalil tik, xchi winhaj José chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ik'jib'at heb' winh yuj winh ilum pat chi', ix sk'anab'ajan winh tas ix yal winhaj José chi'.

Ix te xiw cha'anh heb' winh yujto ix ik'chajb'at heb' winh t'a spat winh, ix yal-lan yab' heb' winh icha tik: --Chuk tas sna winh t'a kib'anh. Tekan yuj k'e'en tumin ix yak' meltzaj heb' winh t'ayonh, yuj chi' tzonh ik'chajkot t'a tik. Tekan ol honh yak'och winh schekab'ok yet' nok' ko chej tik, xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi', ayik ix k'och heb' winh t'a spuerta'il pat chi', ix och te'an heb' winh t'a winh yilumal te' chi'.
Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Mamin, ina ha honh tik, ix honh ulek' manoj trigo jun'el,

haxo yik ix honh meltzaji, ix honh way t'a yol b'e. Ayik ix ko jakan ko koxtal, ix kilani tz'akan yajem k'e'en tumin t'a sti' ko koxtal chi', haton k'e'en ix ko k'ana' ayik ix ko manan ixim ko trigo. Ix kik'anxi meltzaj k'e'en tumin chi' tikne'ik, tz'akan ol kutej kak'anxi k'e'en t'ayach.
Manh kojtakok mach ix ak'anem k'e'en t'a yol sti' ko koxtal chi'. Ch'ok ix kik'paxkot k'e'en stojol ixim ol ko man chi' tikne'ik, xchi heb' winh.

Ix yalan winh chi' icha tik: --Manh heyak' pensar yuj jun chi'. Manh hex xiwok. Ha sDiosal he mam yet' hex paxi, ha ix ak'anem k'e'en t'a sti' he koxtal chi'. Ha hin ix hin cha k'e'en tumin ix heyak' stojolok ixim he trigo ix heyik' chi', xchi winh t'a heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix ik'ji'elta winhaj Simeón t'a yol preso yuj winh yilumal chi', ix elul winh b'aj ayek' heb' yuk'tak chi'.
Ix ik'chajb'at heb' winh smasanil yuj winh t'a spat winhaj José chi', ix yak'an ha ha' winh yik sb'ikel yok heb' winh, ix ak'jipax yanh schej heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ank'eta silab' heb' winh t'a yol skoxtal ol yak' t'a winhaj José ayik ol k'och winh t'a chimk'uhalil chi', yujto yojtakxo heb' winh to ol wa heb' winh yet' winh.
Haxo ix k'och winhaj José chi', ix yak'an silab' heb' winh chi' t'a winh, ix em nhojjab' heb' winh t'a sat lum t'a yichanh winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh tato wach'nhej sk'o'ol heb' winh, ix yalan winh: --¿Janik' sk'o'ol winh he mam, winh te ichamxo ix heyal t'ayin? ¿Pitzan tom winh? xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Ix em nhojan heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh: --Ha winh ko mam chi', ayto'ek' winh, wach'to sk'o'ol winh, xchi heb' winh.

Haxo ix yilanoch winhaj Benjamín winh, haton winh junnhej snun winh yet'ok, ix yalan winh: --¿Ha am winh heyuk'tak tzak'an unin ix heyal tik t'ayin? xchi winh. --Haton winh, xchi heb' winh. --Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Dios t'a ib'anh, xchi winh t'a winhaj Benjamín chi'.

Ixlajwi yalan jun chi' winh, ix te sat wal sk'o'ol winh yilan winh yuk'tak chi'. Ix och pitz'an t'a spixan winh, ijan wal ix ok' winh. Elanhchamel ix b'at lemnaj winh t'a yol scuarto yik sb'at ok' ta'.
Haxo yik ix ek'b'at skusk'olal winh chi', ix sb'ikanel sat winh, ix elta winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' schekab': Ik'ekelta ko wa'el chi' china'ik, xchi winh.

Jun smexa winhaj José chi' sch'okojil. Ch'ok junxo mexa b'aj ix och heb' winh yuk'tak winh chi', ch'ok pax junxo mexa b'aj swa heb' winh aj Egipto chi', haton heb' swataxon yet' winhaj José chi', yujto ha heb' winh aj Egipto chi' ay yowalil tato junnhej swa heb' winh yet' heb' winh hebreo chi'.

Ha heb' winh yuk'tak winhaj José chi', t'a stzolal ix aj yak'ji'em k'ojan heb' winh yuj winh schekab' winhaj José chi', hato syala' jantak sk'inal junjun heb' winh, yujto icha chi' ix aj yalan winhaj José chi'. Winh b'ab'el masanto winh tzak'an unin. Toxonhej ste sat sk'o'ol heb' winh yil-lanoch sb'a.

Ha wa'el ay t'a smexa winhaj José chi', ha' ix ak'ji t'a heb' winh. Haxo pax t'a winhaj Benjamín chi', oye'to makan ek'b'al yik winh ix ak'ji t'a yichanh yik juntzanhxo heb' winh chi'. Ichato chi' ix wa heb' winh, ix yuk'an wino heb' winh t'a tzalajk'olal.
